title: The Slip on the Pinch Pot
youtube_title: The Slip on the Pinch Pot | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A slow finish can be the right finish.
summary: At a ceramic studio table where slip and handles must set, Pema wants to check on a pinch pot still wearing wet clay slip before it is ready. With Nana Ruth nearby, Pema leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
